description:
Himawari is back in all her comical ninja mischief. The sequel to Himiwari continues with the many odd and hilarious adventures of Himawari, Hayate and her Ninja classmates. Season two delves into Himawari and Hayate's Past. Will new secrets be revealed? Will Himawari finally find out about her past and the mysterious ninja that saved her when she was little?

(Source: Anime News Network)
